Subject: Follow-up: route addition + blended-rate ask (post-demo)

Hi Erica — great to meet you and Samir on the call earlier. Quick write-up of the things we said we'd follow up on and an ask so we can build a proposal that aligns with your budget.

Recap from the call:
- DataForge current production traffic: ~0.8M total tokens/month (inference gen only).
- Q3 target: phased step-up to ~4.2M tokens/month across two new routes (customer-facing chat + batch semantic search embeddings).
- Model mix: catwalk:v1 (primary, cheaper gen) for chat; deep-embed:v2 for semantic search. You'll likely split ~70% gen / 30% embeddings by token volume.

What we need from you to finalize a blended rate proposal:
1) Target dollar-per-1M-tokens you're comfortable with for a 12-month committed plan (range is fine). Example: $300–$450 / 1M tokens blended was mentioned as a helpful starting point.
2) Expected ramp cadence (month-by-month or quarter-by-quarter) — you said Q3 is aggressive; a month-by-month ramp helps with capacity and pricing.
3) Any compliance/KMS requirements for Private or Dedicated — you flagged SOC2 and VPC.

Next steps (from our side):
- I'll pull together a blended-rate worksheet with three commitment tiers (base, growth, aggressive) and show per-route blended math (gen vs embed).
- Marissa will add a recommended route-fallback policy for SLA resilience.
- Ben will provide a capacity sketch for Dedicated vs Hosted cost delta.

If you can send a short budget range and a rough ramp (e.g., Jul: 1.2M, Aug: 2.6M, Sep: 4.2M), I’ll return a clean MRP (mutual action plan) + pricing worksheet by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks — Vivek

Summary pricing (12-month commit, monthly billing):
- Model mix assumption: 70% generation traffic (catwalk:v1), 30% embeddings (deep-embed:v2).
- Proposed blended rate (volume-weighted): $338 / 1M tokens (this is between your ideal $320 and your ceiling $420).
- Banded breakout:
   * Generation (catwalk:v1): $300 / 1M tokens
   * Embeddings (deep-embed:v2): $420 / 1M tokens
- If you commit to the aggressive tier (4.8M+ avg/month) we can move blended to $305 / 1M.

Example month (Sep forecasted 4.2M):
- Gen tokens: 2.94M -> $882 (2.94 * $300 / 1M * 1000?) [note: see worksheet for token->pricing math formatted per 1M].
- Embedding tokens: 1.26M -> $529.20
- Sep total est: $1,411.20 (blended $336 / 1M) — worksheet has exact rounding.

Compliance / capacity notes:
- SOC2 + KMS: Hosted + Customer-managed KMS integration supported; VPC peering available as optional add-on (4–6 week setup).
- Dedicated footprint recommendation: for steady 4.2–5.0M with burst to 6M tokens, we recommend a 2-GPU Dedicated pool (NVIDIA H100 equiv) with autoscale buffer. Cost delta vs hosted captured in worksheet.

Next steps / mutual action plan (attached doc):
1) DataForge: confirm target commitment tier (base / growth / aggressive) and accept target blended range — Erica by Tue 7/6.
2) Redwood: if accepted, we deliver a redline-friendly SOW + initial invoice estimate and submit SOC2 evidence pack — Vivek by Fri 7/2.
